title: Jerusalem Tour - The Holy City
overview: Discover the ancient city of Jerusalem, one of the world's oldest cities and sacred to Judaism, Christianity, and Islam. Visit the Dead Sea, Mount of Olives, Western Wall, Via Dolorosa, and more in this full-day guided tour.
highlights: The Dead Sea - Float effortlessly in the saltiest body of water
The Mount of Olives - A spectacular view over the Old City & Temple Mount
Gethsemane - The site where Jesus spent his last night before arrest
Mount Zion - Visit The Last Supper Room & Dormition Abbey
Western Wall - The holiest site in Judaism
Via Dolorosa - Walk the path where Jesus carried the Cross
Church of the Holy Sepulcher - The site of Jesus’ crucifixion and tomb
Jaffa Gate - Exit through one of the most historic gates of Jerusalem
extra_tips: Entry visa is included in the price.
If traveling to Cairo or Luxor after Jerusalem, do not obtain an entry visa for Cairo/Luxor until you return.
It's better to visit Cairo or Luxor before Jerusalem if both are booked.
Tailor-made private tours are available for larger groups upon request.
recommendations: Bring towels & swimwear for the Dead Sea
